thoughts: My first shiny. 26k encounters to get here was rough. It appeared on the left and I just stared in disbelief. Shinies were real, and the hunt had begun.
Painful. Looking back, my first two shinies both were. A week of grinding, down to my last berry when it finally showed. I held it for a week, then sold it.
Where my luck started to turn. The morning after we'd gone out, still in bed: tabbed away, tabbed back, and there it was.
Beautiful. I always deliver on 100% hordes. About a day's work, counting the encounters before it.
A long dry spell, then the next morning, six Sweet Scents in, it appeared.
A tough one. I felt bone dry, bouncing between here and Dragon's Den before settling back at Celestial Tower. Tilted and grinding at 4 a.m., for real.
I wish it weren't a Magikarp, but it is what it is. Done with Dragon's Den for a while.
Easy work. I knew it was coming.
Unbelievable. No words. The luck is finally turning.
